name: meeko-monorepo
description: Workspace of @meekojs/meeko, its editor and DevTools extensions and the documentation site.

scripts.check:apps: pnpm -F meeko-site run check && pnpm -F meeko-ui-site run check && pnpm -F meeko-i18n-site run check
scripts.i18n:build: pnpm -F @meekojs/meeko run build && pnpm -F @meekojs/ui run build && pnpm -F @meekojs/i18n run build && pnpm -F meeko-i18n-site run build
scripts.site:build: pnpm -F @meekojs/meeko run build && pnpm -F meeko-site run build
scripts.test:packages: node --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/ui/tests/*.test.mjs packages/i18n/tests/*.test.mjs packages/icon/tests/*.test.mjs packages/eslint-plugin/tests/*.test.mjs packages/prettier-plugin/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/build-package.test.mjs scripts/deploy-dockerfile.test.mjs scripts/design-tokens-check.test.mjs scripts/generated-sources.test.mjs scripts/git-guard.test.mjs scripts/publish-packages.test.mjs scripts/sync-agents.test.mjs
scripts.tooling:build: pnpm -F @meekojs/meeko run build && pnpm -F @meekojs/eslint-plugin run build && pnpm -F @meekojs/prettier-plugin run build
scripts.ui:build: pnpm -F @meekojs/meeko run build && pnpm -F @meekojs/ui run build && pnpm -F meeko-ui-site run build
scripts.verify: pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run design:check && pnpm -F @meekojs/meeko run verify && pnpm -F meeko-devtools-extension run check
